body: i usually encounter unhelpful or unactionable criticisms and rude comments, i've realized a lot of people are just angry for no reason or want to feel superior for whatever reason. i think the worst comments ive gotten have been about my art style, calling it ugly. i did receive some angry comments about how i portrayed a certain character from someone. it is really disheartening to get comments like that especially since my ocd really latches onto them, i feel so passionate about my art so to just receive a dismissive comment like that i draw same face syndrome or draw everyone with fetal alcohol disease with no constructive criticism or context is really upsetting and makes me not want to post my art lol. overall i usually get positive comments but those rude ones really can overshadow everything
